entities.createSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` (`mediaId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `uri` TEXT NOT NULL, `displayName` TEXT NOT NULL, `dateTaken` INTEGER NOT NULL, `text` TEXT NOT NULL, `sourceApp` TEXT, `category` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OTHER', PRIMARY KEY(`mediaId`))
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `${TABLE_NAME}` USING FTS4(`text` TEXT NOT NULL, tokenize=unicode61, content=`screenshots`)
contentSyncTriggers: CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_screenshots_fts_BEFORE_UPDATE BEFORE UPDATE ON `screenshots` BEGIN DELETE FROM `screenshots_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_screenshots_fts_BEFORE_DELETE BEFORE DELETE ON `screenshots` BEGIN DELETE FROM `screenshots_fts` WHERE `docid`=OLD.`rowid`; END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_screenshots_fts_AFTER_UPDATE AFTER UPDATE ON `screenshots` BEGIN INSERT INTO `screenshots_fts`(`docid`, `text`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`text`); END

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS room_fts_content_sync_screenshots_fts_AFTER_INSERT AFTER INSERT ON `screenshots` BEGIN INSERT INTO `screenshots_fts`(`docid`, `text`) VALUES (NEW.`rowid`, NEW.`text`); END
